tenderSchedule.description: DISMANTLING, TRANSPORTATION (TO & FRO), REPAIR OF FAULTY POWER TRANSFORMER, ASSEMBLING, TESTING, ERECTION AND COMMISSIONING OF REPAIRED POWER TRANSFORMER OF 220 KV AND ABOVE VOLTAGE CLASS AT KPTCL DESTINED STATION ON RATE CONTRACT BASIS
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPTCL CGM Tech Corporate Office Bengaluru

generalCriterionList.description: The bidder should not have been disqualified for non-performance in any of the Government utilities in the past five years and bidder shall furnish a self-declaration to this effect, failing which the offer is liable to be rejected.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should have minimum 05 (five) years experience in manufacturing / repairing, testing and commissioning of 220KV or higher voltage class Power Transformers on total turnkey basis (involving designing, manufacturing and replacement of faulty windings of Power Transformer) which has been supplied/repaired for any of the Government / public utility in India.

Bidder should have supplied/repaired minimum 2 nos. of 220 kV voltage class Transformers or 1 no of 400 kV voltage class transformer for any of the Government /public utility in India in the past ten years from the date of opening of the tender and such transformer/s should have rendered satisfactory service for a period of at least 18(eighteen) months from the date of commissioning

The Cash at bank and term deposits with bank as on 31.07.2026 or at a later date but before opening of technical bid shall be supported by a Bank certificate, ensuring the availability of fund based credit facility from Nationalized / Scheduled commercial bank with whom the bidder has the banking facility as on 31.01.2026 or later.
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditors reports for the last five years

The Bidder shall have Minimum Average Annual Turnover (MAAT) of not less than Rs.100 lakhs considered for best 3 years out of the last five years preceding the date of bid submission. (i.e. FY20-21 to FY 2024-25)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works

The bidder should not have been disqualified for non-performance in any of the Government utilities in the past five years and bidder shall furnish a self-declaration to this effect, failing which the offer is liable to be rejected.

The offer of the bidder is liable for rejection in following cases- i) Where the Zonal Chief Engineers/ CEE (T&P) have issued notices in respect of ongoing works in the last 6 months as on date of bid submission invoking Risk & Cost clause and where the work is not completed/charged.Wherethe zonal Chief Engineers/ CEE(T&P)have issued notices in the last 6 months as on date of bid submission invoking Risk & Cost clause and where the work is completed by KPTCL entrusting it to some other agencyWherein the works awarded by KPTCL to the bidder has been short closed invoking clause No.44.0 & 45.0 of GCC (Contractors default) then such bidder shall not be eligible if such short closure has been initiated within 6 months prior to last date of bid submission of this tender

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Relevant Documents as specified in IFB

technicalCriterionList.description: Any bidder from a country which shares a land border with India will be eligible to bid onlt if the bidder is registered with a competent authority,
Power of Attorney
Letter of Undertaking

The Bidder should have established own workshop to accommodate and repair EHV Transformers, and should maintain dust free environment for winding works and should have the essential equipment as per tender document.
The qualification and experience of key personnel proposed for carrying out the work
Evidence of access to lines of credit and availability of other financial resources
Description of the tools & plant available with them for execution of the work
Any bidder from a country which shares a land border with India will be eligible to bid only if the bidder is registered with a competent authority

The empanelled bidders of the previous tenders awarded for Repair of 31.5 MVA & below capacity Power Transformers are not allowed to participate in the tender as the previous rate contract is for a period is 2 years
Bidder should possess all statutory permissions for repair of the Power Transformer in his premises
While computing the balance works on hand pertaining to KPTCL, only those works where the financial progress is less than 50% shall be reckoned on the entire award amount.
The bidder should have valid GST registration with GSTIN number.
No Deviation Certificate

The Bidder shall have necessary facilities at his own works for carrying out all routine tests mentioned in this specification including facility to carry out special tests namely Temperature Rise Test, etc. on a repaired Power Transformer as prescribed in the latest IS:2026 1977 or any relevant standard as applicable for testing of repaired Power Transformer. The testing facilities shall have testing and measuring instruments calibrated by National Accreditation Board for Testing and Calibration Laboratories (NABL). Valid calibration reports of Testing and measuring instruments shall be uploaded to the e-portal. KPTCL may consider issue of 110KV Power Transformers for repair only to those empaneled repairers who possess lightning impulse test setup (including lightning impulse generator and allied equipments OR Repairer can get lightning impulse test done at any approved NABL lab in the country in the presence of KPTCL representative at no extra cost to KPTCL
Any other agreements/undertakings specified in the Tender

Copies of original documents defining the Constitution or legal status, place of registration and principal place of business of the Bidder, written power of attorney to the signatory of the bid to commit the Bidder to the contract along with the resolution passed in this regard by the Board of Directors / all the partners of the Firm

The already empaneled bidders of the previous tenders awarded for Repair of 31.5 MVA & below capacity Power Transformers whose contract period validity is ending in less than 6 months as on the date of submission of the bid are only allowed to participate in this tender.
